title: Permit authored living-spec prose without weakening the store boundary (#1197)
intent: Implement the narrow compatibility fix for #1197: generated agent instructions must permit agents to read and edit the authored semantic prose of .decapod/managed/specs/*.md, while machine-owned Decapod state, generated attestations, manifests, governance JSON, and databases remain CLI/RPC-only. Preserve the material-spec and proof gates; add no new authority or contract surface.
